title: valetkey.toml
description: valetkey.toml: the targets an AI agent may use through valetkey without seeing their secrets.

min_version.description: The oldest valetkey version this file works with, e.g. "0.1".

require_fence.description: Use protected secrets only when the agent is fenced (default true).

targets.description: Targets by id (1–63 characters of a-z, 0-9, '.', '_', '-').

SecretRef.description: Where the broker fetches the secret: env-file://<path>#<KEY>, local://<id>, keyring://<service>/<account> or gcp-sm://<project>/<name>. Never the secret itself.

database.description: The database name. The broker verifies it with `current_database()` on every connect.

description.description: Free text for humans and the agent.

host.description:
TCP host. Only for targets whose secret is exposed (e.g. `env-file://`); a protected secret
must use `socket` (§6.2).

socket.description: Socket alias: the proxy listens on `~/.valetkey/sockets/<alias>/.s.PGSQL.5432`.

user.description: The login role. Use a dedicated role per target, never the application's (§6.9).
